sourceMarkup:
'''Levels''' are Tower Defense Simulator's internal experience system. Each player starts at '''Level''' 0, but as they play through the game, they will earn {{Exp|}}, allowing them to reach higher '''Levels'''. Higher '''Levels''' require higher amounts of {{Exp|}} to reach. Reaching certain '''Levels''' unlocks new parts of the game or grants the player special rewards. The amount of {{Exp|}} needed to level up can be seen in your Level Bar at the bottom of your screen in the lobby.

==Exp Requirements==
Below lists the formula for levelling up. 

{| class="wikitable pad-5 align-center" style="margin: 1em auto;"
! Levels 
!EXP Required 
|-
| <big><math>0 \rightarrow 10</math> 
| <big><math>45 + (\text{Next Level} \times 3.5)</math></big> 
|-
| <big><math> 10 \rightarrow 40 </math>
| <big><math>\text{Next Level} \times 8</math></big> 
|-
| <big><math> \ge 41 </math>
| <big><math>260 + (\text{Next Level} \times 1.5)</math></big> 
|}

Prior to the [[Overhaul Update]], the formula was as follows: 

{| class="wikitable pad-5 align-center" style="margin: 1em auto;"
! Levels
!EXP Required 
|-
| All
| <big><math>35 + (\text{Current Level} \times 2.5)</math></big> 
|}

==Rewards==
Prior to the [[v1.65.0|Skill Tree Update]], every fifth '''Level''' increased the amount of base health you had by 2, unless the map or mode had the [[HP Locked]] modifier. Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], each '''Level''' increased base health by 1. Before 18th of June 2019, '''Levels''' did not increase base health. The [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]] formula for calculating base health was:
:<big> <math>100 + \left(\frac{\text{Player Levels}}{5} \times 2\right)</math> </big>
Reaching some '''Levels''' also unlock new towers, like the [[Crook Boss]] or [[Turret]], while other thresholds unlock new parts of the game, like special maps or [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode.
